保存当前设置，并在指定页码范围内创建或更新进度条。: Save the current settings and create or update the indicators in the specified slide range.
移除指定范围内的进度条。配置仍会保留，之后可点击“生成”恢复。: Remove the indicators from the specified slides. Your settings are saved. Select Generate to restore the indicators.
选择“进度均长”让每一页的横条等长，章节宽度随页数变化。选择“章节均长”让各章节: Choose Equal Slides to give each slide the same width. Sections then grow with their slide count. Choose Equal Sections to give each section the same width and divide it among its slides. With bar markers off, these settings control icon spacing.
每一页的横条等长: Give every slide marker the same width
每页占据相同宽度，章节宽度与其可见页数成正比。关闭横条模式时为图标等距。: Each visible slide takes the same width. Section width is proportional to its visible slide count. With bar markers off, icons are evenly spaced.
各章节占据相同宽度: Give every section the same width
每章等宽，章节内按可见页数分配横条长度。关闭横条模式时为章节等宽。: Each section takes the same width and divides it among its visible slides. Sections stay equally wide when bar markers are off.
选择同时显示章节和图标、仅显示图标，或仅显示章节。: Show both sections and icons, icons only, or sections only.
从此页开始绘制。进度仍按整份演示文稿计算。可输入 1 至 999；页码范围不随演: Start drawing on this slide. Progress still uses the entire presentation. Enter 1 to 999. The slide range is not saved with the presentation.
绘制到此页为止。可输入 1 至 999；页码范围不随演示文稿保存。: Draw through this slide. Enter 1 to 999. The slide range is not saved with the presentation.
每次更改功能区设置后重新生成进度条。较长的演示文稿建议关闭，修改完成后再点击“生: Regenerate indicators whenever a ribbon setting changes. For long presentations, turn this off and select Generate when you finish making changes.
仅更新最多 3 张符合范围与显示规则的页面，其余页面保持原样。确认效果后点击“生: Update up to three slides that meet the range and visibility settings. When you are ready, select Generate to update all eligible slides in the range.
查看使用说明、作者信息及原版更新。作者网站：https://datenbank-: Find instructions, author information, and updates to the original add-in at https://datenbank-projekt.de.
选择 PowerPoint 内置形状、随机形状或自定义图片。: Choose a built-in PowerPoint shape, a random shape, or a custom picture.
分别为已讲、当前和未讲三种状态选择图片。: Choose separate pictures for past, current, and upcoming slides.
为每个进度图标随机选择一种形状。: Choose a shape at random for each progress icon.
同侧双圆角矩形: Rectangle with Two Adjacent Rounded Corners
同侧双圆角矩形 (Round2SameRectangle): Rectangle with Two Adjacent Rounded Corners (Round2SameRectangle)
同侧双剪角矩形: Rectangle with Two Adjacent Snipped Corners
同侧双剪角矩形 (Snip2SameRectangle): Rectangle with Two Adjacent Snipped Corners (Snip2SameRectangle)
剪角圆角矩形: Rectangle with One Snipped and One Rounded Corner
剪角圆角矩形 (SnipRoundRectangle): Rectangle with One Snipped and One Rounded Corner (SnipRoundRectangle)
依次增加轮廓线宽；超过最大值后隐藏轮廓。: Increase the outline weight one step at a time. After the maximum, the outline is hidden.
依次减小轮廓线宽；减至零后隐藏，再次点击会返回最大值。: Decrease the outline weight one step at a time. At zero, the outline disappears. Select again to return to the maximum.
循环切换单线、双细线、细粗线、粗细线和三重线。: Cycle through single, double, thin-thick, thick-thin, and triple lines.
循环切换实线、方点、圆点、短划线和点划线。: Cycle through solid lines, square dots, round dots, dashes, and dash-dot lines.
设置已讲页面的进度图标颜色。可选择主题色或输入 RGB 数值。: Set the icon color for past slides. Choose a theme color or enter RGB values.
设置当前页面的进度图标颜色。可选择主题色或输入 RGB 数值。: Set the icon color for the current slide. Choose a theme color or enter RGB values.
设置未讲页面的进度图标颜色。可选择主题色或输入 RGB 数值。: Set the icon color for upcoming slides. Choose a theme color or enter RGB values.
勾选后，使用所选颜色填充已讲进度图标。: Fill icons for past slides with the selected color.
勾选后，使用所选颜色填充当前进度图标。: Fill the current slide icon with the selected color.
勾选后，使用所选颜色填充未讲进度图标。: Fill icons for upcoming slides with the selected color.
0 表示不透明，100 表示完全透明。: Use 0 for opaque or 100 for fully transparent.
输入字体名称，或从下拉列表选择。字体名称保持其系统名称。: Enter a font name or choose one from the list. Fonts appear under their system names.
读取已安装字体时可能短暂打开 Microsoft Word。再次使用此项前，需先: Microsoft Word may open briefly to read the list of installed fonts. Before using this option again, select another font in the list.
章节标题放在图标下方: Place section titles below the icons
勾选后，章节名称位于图标下方；取消勾选后，章节名称位于图标上方。: Select to place section names below the icons. Clear to place them above.
设置已讲章节的文字颜色。可选择主题色或输入 RGB 数值。: Set the text color for past sections. Choose a theme color or enter RGB values.
设置当前章节的文字颜色。可选择主题色或输入 RGB 数值。: Set the text color for the current section. Choose a theme color or enter RGB values.
设置未讲章节的文字颜色。可选择主题色或输入 RGB 数值。: Set the text color for upcoming sections. Choose a theme color or enter RGB values.
勾选后，为已讲章节显示背景色。: Show a background color for past sections.
勾选后，为当前章节显示背景色。: Show a background color for the current section.
勾选后，为未讲章节显示背景色。: Show a background color for upcoming sections.
设置已讲章节的背景颜色。需勾选对应的背景开关。: Set the background color for past sections. Turn on Fill Past Sections to display it.
设置当前章节的背景颜色。需勾选对应的背景开关。: Set the background color for the current section. Turn on Fill Current Section to display it.
设置未讲章节的背景颜色。需勾选对应的背景开关。: Set the background color for upcoming sections. Turn on Fill Upcoming Sections to display it.
顶部、底部或左右侧栏: Dock at the top, bottom, left, or right
章节顺序沿所选边排列。侧栏章节名保持正常横排，进度页条沿侧边竖向排列；章节均长和: Sections run along the selected edge. In sidebars, section names read horizontally and slide markers run vertically. Both spacing modes are available. The connecting strip in a layered design faces the slide content and casts no shadow at that edge.
左右侧栏的厚度: Width of the left or right sidebar
输入 48 至 240，默认 96 pt。只影响左右停靠。章节沿侧边长度仍由均长: Enter 48 to 240 pt. The default is 96 pt. This setting applies to sidebars. The spacing mode controls section lengths along the edge. Text and marker spacing follow the layout settings.
从每页实际使用的母版主题取色: Use the theme from each slide's master
使用目标页主题的 Accent 1、浅色和深色生成主要底板、文字、页条与标记颜色: Use Accent 1 and the light and dark theme colors for panels, text, slide markers, and accents. Solid slide backgrounds help determine light or dark panels. Picture and gradient backgrounds use the theme colors without sampling the slide. Custom gradient and backdrop text colors stay as set. Turn this off for a fixed palette. Crimson Layers uses a fixed palette by default.
只在指定母版或版式的页面上显示: Show indicators only on slides using a specific master or layout
多规则停用时使用此单一绑定。绑定不改变进度分母，不向母版添加图形；页面导航仍独立: This rule applies when multiple rules are off. Progress counts stay the same, and indicators remain editable on individual slides. No shapes are added to the slide master. The rule still matches if you rename or reorder its target. A copy counts as a new target. Requires an XML format such as .pptx or .pptm.
按母版或版式显示不同样式，或隐藏导航: Apply styles or hide indicators by master or layout
把当前配置保存为显示或隐藏规则。精确版式优先于母版，再使用未匹配页面的默认显示动: Save the current settings as a show or hide rule. A layout rule takes priority over its master rule. Unmatched slides use the default action. Manually hidden indicators take precedence. All rules share the overall slide count. Save up to 32 rules per presentation. Generate checks all enabled rules and reports invalid targets before removing indicators.
在当前章节显示页码或百分比: Show a slide count or percentage in the current section
使用与进度条一致的有效页统计，遵守全局隐藏页、跳过页和重复页规则。计数不会随当前: Count slides by the same rules as the indicators, including hidden, skipped, and repeated slides. Updating a subset of slides does not change the count.
控制长文稿的标记密度: Set marker density for long presentations
全部页面保留逐页标记。自动密度在空间不足时合并进度标记。当前章节聚焦让其他章节以: All Slides shows a marker for each slide. Auto Density combines markers when space is tight. Focus on Current Section shows a summary bar for each other section. Density does not change the slide count.
自动密度的最小标记长度: Minimum marker length for Auto Density
输入 2 至 20 pt，默认 4 pt。空间不足时按密度模式汇总显示。: Enter 2 to 20 pt. The default is 4 pt. The density setting controls how markers are grouped when space runs out.
只改变生成的文字，不修改章节名: Change the displayed text while keeping the original section name
轻量原生矢量装饰，不附带素材库: Add lines with native PowerPoint shapes
使用分号分隔的 RGB 数值: Separate the RGB values with semicolons
例如 107;114;128。启用主题跟色时线条跟随章节前景色；关闭主题跟色后使: For example, enter 107;114;128. With slide theme colors on, lines use the section text color. Turn theme colors off to use this RGB value.
只生成或更新当前页面: Generate or update indicators on the current slide
仅修改当前页，仍遵守起止页码、显示绑定和隐藏规则。进度分母仍按整份文稿计算。: Update only the current slide, subject to the slide range, master and layout settings, and visibility rules. Progress still uses the entire presentation.
只生成或更新选中的页面: Generate or update indicators on the selected slides
在缩略图窗格或幻灯片浏览视图中多选页面。只修改所选页与起止页码范围的交集，其他页: Select slides in the thumbnail pane or Slide Sorter view. This command updates selected slides within the specified slide range.
移除所选页范围内的导航: Remove indicators from selected slides in range
仅删除所选页与起止页码范围交集中的进度条图形。保留配置和显示资格，下次生成可恢复: Remove indicator shapes from selected slides within the specified range. The settings and visibility rules are saved, so Generate can restore the indicators.
隐藏导航，但保留进度计数: Hide indicators and keep the existing progress count
移除所有所选页的现有导航并保存逐页隐藏标记。后续生成也不显示，这些页面仍计入原有: Remove indicators from all selected slides and keep them hidden on future runs. The slides still count according to the existing rules for skipped, repeated, and hidden slides.
清除逐页隐藏标记并更新所选页: Clear manual hiding and update the selected slides
恢复所选页的导航显示资格，再按起止页码范围与母版/版式绑定生成。不会覆盖 Pow: Make the selected slides eligible for indicators again. The slide range, master or layout rules, PowerPoint's hidden-slide setting, and existing skip rules still apply.
同章、相同主题、版式和背景的页面复用兼容的导航结构，再更新页条状态，减少重复绘制: Slides in the same section with the same theme, layout, and background can reuse the same indicator shapes. Only the slide marker states need to change, reducing redraws and shadow captures. The cache lasts for this run. Turn this off to redraw every slide.
查看实际生成耗时和复用情况: View elapsed time and indicator reuse
40 款导航预设，每款均有三种尺寸: 40 indicator designs, each in three sizes
展开预设后选择大号、中号或小号。上下停靠时，小号章体高 13 pt（深红层叠为: Open a preset and choose Large, Medium, or Small. With top or bottom docking, Small panels are 13 pt high, or 16 pt for Crimson Layers. Medium and Large panels are 30% taller than the same preset and size in 11.4. The indicators fill the selected edge and keep your sidebar width, visibility rules, slide range, spacing mode, counts, and density. Select Preview or Generate to see the result.
主题色标出当前栏，连续细轨上的粗游标定位当前页。: The theme color highlights the current section. A thicker segment on the thin track marks the current slide.
独立胶囊承载章节，圆点标页，实心与空心区分已讲和未讲。: Each section has its own pill. Filled and outlined dots distinguish past and upcoming slides.
圆角模块分隔章节，编号与方块页标形成双层网格。: Rounded panels separate the sections. Section numbers and square slide markers form a two-level grid.
半透明胶囊之间留空，圆节点在每个胶囊内标记页进度。: Translucent pills sit apart, with a row of dots inside each pill to show slide progress.
柔和圆角分区使用低面积的连续轨道，当前页加粗。: Gently rounded panels contain a slim, continuous track that thickens at the current slide.
错位实色底板承托章节卡，方块页标用实心和空心区分进度。: An offset solid shadow lifts each section card. Filled and hollow squares show slide progress.
等宽章节索引由分隔线划开；方块模拟终端的字符位置。: Dividers separate monospaced section labels. Square markers resemble character cells on a terminal.
衬线栏题与栏线组成编辑版面，逐页刻度按五页分组。: Serif headings and column rules form an editorial layout. Slide ticks are grouped in fives.
深红当前章与连接条无缝相接，外缘带柔和投影。圆角页标占每章中间的 80%。当前页: The crimson section and strip join seamlessly with a soft outer shadow. Rounded markers span the middle 80% of each section. The current marker glows. Other markers are 48% as thick and 70% transparent. Small panels are 16 pt high at the top or bottom.
轻影章节面各自成片，内置细小圆节点；当前章节带下沿标识。: Each section has its own softly shadowed panel and small dots. A line along the lower edge marks the current section.
垂直细线划开栏目，下沿突出当前章，粗细轨道表示页进度。: Fine vertical rules divide the columns. The bottom edge marks the current section, and the track changes weight to show slide progress.
上沿定位当前栏，等距长短刻度逐页推进。: The top edge marks the current column. Evenly spaced long and short ticks track slide progress.
浅色调圆角版块之间留空，当前面加深，圆节点显示页状态。: Pale rounded panels sit apart. The current panel darkens, and dots show each slide's state.
实色当前模块配宽幅直角页段，后续章节留出模块间隙。: A solid current panel contains wide, square-ended slide markers. Gaps separate the upcoming section panels.
侧边强调与整块柔影区分章节面，细轨加粗的位置标记当前页。: A side accent and a soft shadow define each section panel. A thicker segment on the thin track marks the current slide.
章节和未讲页都使用轮廓；小方块逐格填实。: Fine outlines define sections and upcoming slides. Small squares fill in as you advance.
编号栏头与细栏线构成目录，长短页刻度沿栏目推进。: Numbered column headings and fine rules form an index. Long and short ticks track progress within each column.
黑白反转突出当前网格，直角页段与章节边线共享直角结构。: The current cell reverses black and white. Square-ended slide markers echo the section borders.
亮底重框划分章节，通过方格轮廓、实心和反色区分三种状态。: Heavy borders separate sections on a light background. Outlined, filled, and reversed squares distinguish the three slide states.
暗底高对比章节框搭配圆节点，未讲页以空心表示。: High-contrast frames on a dark background contain dots. Outlined dots mark upcoming slides.
带浅色边框和柔影的半透明独立面板，以圆节点标记页位。: Separate translucent panels have light borders and soft shadows. Dots mark slide positions.
带细框和阴影的深色半透明面板内，当前页游标沿细轨移动。: Dark translucent panels have fine borders and shadows. A cursor marks the current slide on a thin track.
暗色分栏上的圆节点按页点亮，当前节点有光晕。: Dots light up along dark columns as the slides advance. The current dot glows.
十字对位标记定位章节端点，稠密的长短页刻度呈现工程图读数。: Crosshairs mark section ends. Dense groups of long and short ticks resemble a scale on an engineering drawing.
双侧色阶表达章节距离，连续页轨用厚度区分已讲、当前和未讲。: Colors step away from the current section on both sides. Track thickness distinguishes past, current, and upcoming slides.
细线划开渐变色域，节点沿章节排列，用填充和光晕提示位置。: Fine lines divide the color steps. Dots mark slides within each section, using fill and glow to show your place.
带柔影的纸页用索引卡折角线分区，逐页刻度与衬线标题对齐。: Soft shadows and folded index card marks define the paper panels. Slide ticks align with serif headings.
粗框模块与较大的方形页标形成两级尺度。: Heavy frames divide the panels. Large square markers show individual slides within each one.
矩形取景框围合栏目，框内成排小窗标页，当前窗以实心强调。: Rectangular frames enclose each section. Small windows mark the slides, and a solid window marks the current slide.
十字对位点界定章节，逐页刻度每五页伸长一次。: Crosshairs mark section boundaries. Every fifth slide has a longer tick.
四角界标围合章节，圆形页节点在方框内部构成第二层导航。: Four corner marks frame each section. A row of dots inside the frame shows individual slides.
编号章节格包含方形页格；填充变化发生在读者所在的单元内。: Numbered section cells contain square slide markers. The fill changes within the active cell.
衬线书目栏使用轻量界线；近似发丝的页轨在当前页加粗。: Fine rules separate the serif columns. A hairline track thickens at the current slide.
双行标尺与编号样本栏对应，章节内的刻度标出页位。: A double rule accompanies numbered specimen columns. Ticks mark the slides within each section.
轻字标题配索引标签端线，点状页标像逐项排列的标本。: Lightweight headings and index label marks define the sections. Dots line up like a row of specimens.
等宽编号和短折角端线模仿档案卡，实心或空心方格表示取阅进度。: Monospaced numbers and short corner marks resemble archive cards. Filled and hollow squares show slide progress.
色带与细分界保留连贯的地平线，页轨通过粗细显示行进位置。: Bands of color and narrow dividers form a continuous horizon. The track changes thickness to show your position.
泳道边界围住一条连续页轨，当前页加粗为游标。: Lane boundaries enclose a continuous track. A thicker segment marks the current slide.
细栏线、衬线栏题和粗上沿组织栏目，长短刻度指示页位。: Fine vertical rules, serif headings, and a heavier top edge organize the columns. Long and short ticks mark slide positions.
分格柜体内嵌直角格条；实心、反白和空框表现各页状态。: Rectangular slide markers fit into framed compartments. Solid, reversed, and outlined cells distinguish the slide states.
沿所选边完整铺满章节与连接条: Extend sections and the connecting strip along the entire edge
沿边起点和终点边距设为 0，导航长度自动使用整条页面边，连接条同步铺满。上下停靠: Set the start and end margins to 0 and fit the indicators and connecting strip to the full slide width or height. The dock edge, distance from the edge, spacing mode, and colors stay as set.
平面章节底板的圆角比例: Corner radius for flat section panels
输入 0 至 50。仅在层叠导航关闭时生效。0 保持原有无缝直角色块；连续层叠轮: Enter 0 to 50. Applies when layered navigation is off. Use 0 for seamless, square-cornered panels. In a connected layered design, sections always meet at square corners.
平面底板下方的实色偏移: Offset of the solid shadow behind flat panels
输入 0 至 8，0 关闭。仅在层叠导航关闭时生效，用一个原生实色矩形构成硬边错: Enter 0 to 8. Use 0 to turn the shadow off. Applies when layered navigation is off. A solid PowerPoint rectangle creates the hard shadow without blur or PNG capture.
选择内容侧、外侧、轮廓或起点标记: Choose a content edge, outer edge, outline, or start edge accent
标记随停靠边转换方向，并保持在章节范围内。内容侧线位于靠正文的一侧，外侧线靠页面: The accent follows the dock edge and stays within the section. The content edge faces the slide content. The outer edge faces the slide edge. The start edge is where the section begins. Layered outlines stay open along the connecting strip. Flat panels use a full outline.
当前章标记的线条粗细: Line weight for the current section accent
输入 0.5 至 4，默认 1.5。章节很窄时自动收细，标记始终保持在本章节范围: Enter 0.5 to 4 pt. The default is 1.5 pt. The accent narrows to fit small sections and stays inside the section.
独立选择当前章标记颜色: Choose a color for the current section accent
在可见章节名前显示 01、02 等序号: Show 01, 02, and so on before visible section names
只修改进度条中的显示文字，不改动 PowerPoint 原始节名。隐藏章节标题保: Show numbers in the indicators while preserving the original PowerPoint section names. Hidden titles remain blank. Backdrop text uses the displayed title when enabled.
使用字重强化当前章节: Emphasize the current section with bold type
用空心横条区分尚未讲到的页面: Show upcoming slides as outlined bars
仅对圆角横条模式生效。已讲页和当前页保持实心，当前章内尚未讲到的页也使用空心样式: Applies to the rounded bar mode. Past and current slides keep their solid fills. Upcoming slides in the current section also receive outlines. Slide transparency and the current slide glow remain independent.
让横条与所在章节文字使用相同的最终颜色: Use the final section text color for its slide bars
仅改变圆角横条的颜色。已讲、当前和未讲页的透明度仍按页面状态设置；当前光晕跟随最: Change the color of the rounded bars. Transparency still follows each slide's state, and the current slide glow matches the final color. Turn this off to use separate colors for past, current, and upcoming slides.
关闭时使用原来的图标或自定义图片: Turn off to use the original icons or custom pictures
输入 0.5 至 12，默认 2.5 pt。极密集布局会适当减小高度，保持扁平比: Enter 0.5 to 12 pt. The default is 2.5 pt. In very dense layouts, markers become shorter to retain their flat proportions.
输入 0 至 20，默认 3 pt。间距只影响横条，不影响无缝章节色块。空间不足: Enter 0 to 20 pt. The default is 3 pt. Spacing applies to bars only. Section panels still meet without gaps. Gaps narrow automatically when space is tight.
圆角相对于横条短边的比例: Corner radius as a percentage of the bar's shorter side
输入 0 至 50。0 为直角，50 为圆润端头，默认 50。: Enter 0 to 50. Use 0 for square corners or 50 for fully rounded ends. The default is 50.
仅为当前页横条增加柔和光晕: Add a soft glow to the current slide bar
光晕颜色跟随当前横条的实际颜色。每张幻灯片仅突出该页对应的横条，章节色块不发光。: The glow follows the bar's color. On each slide, only its own bar glows. Section panels do not glow.
当前横条周围的发光范围: Extent of the glow around the current bar
输入 0 至 20，默认 4 pt。数值越大，光晕覆盖范围越大。: Enter 0 to 20 pt. The default is 4 pt. Larger values spread the glow farther.
当前页光晕的透明度: Transparency of the current slide glow
输入 0 至 100，默认 55。数值越高，光晕越轻。横条本身的透明度仍由进度图: Enter 0 to 100. The default is 55. Higher values give a fainter glow. Icon settings control bar transparency separately for the three slide states.
让章节背景同时包住标题与进度标记: Use one section background behind the title and markers
在完整模式下，将章节背景扩展到进度标记下方。使用章节区的已讲、当前和未讲背景颜色: In Show All mode, extend the section background behind the slide markers. Panels use the section background colors for past, current, and upcoming sections.
文字与进度自动对比: Auto Contrast for Text and Markers
根据透明度合成后的底色选择深色或白色: Choose dark or white based on the blended background color
章节色块启用时，根据底板与页面背景合成后的颜色调整章节文字和内置进度标记，不改变: When section panels are on, adjust the color of section text and built-in markers to the panel blended with the slide background. Text and marker transparency stay as set. Works with flat, gradient, and layered designs. Picture and gradient slide backgrounds use white as a reference. Custom pictures keep their colors.
按章节顺序从相邻色到远端色逐格过渡: Step from the nearest section color to the farthest on each side
当前章保留独立颜色。已讲侧和未讲侧分别从相邻格颜色过渡到远端色，每格为一种纯色，: The current section keeps its own color. On each side, sections step from the nearest to the farthest color, with one solid color per section. A side with only one section uses the nearest color. The gradient runs left to right when docked horizontally and top to bottom in sidebars.
当前章前一章的颜色: Color of the section immediately before the current section
打开颜色选择器，可使用调色板或输入 RGB 数值。: Open the color picker to use the palette or enter RGB values.
已讲侧章节按位置在相邻色和远端色之间插值。: Each past section gets a color between the nearest and farthest colors according to its position.
当前章后一章的颜色: Color of the section immediately after the current section
未讲侧章节按位置在相邻色和远端色之间插值。: Each upcoming section gets a color between the nearest and farthest colors according to its position.
输入 0 至 100。0 表示完全不透明，100 表示背景完全透明。: Enter 0 to 100. Use 0 for opaque or 100 for a fully transparent background.
当前章之前所有色块的背景透明度: Background transparency for all sections before the current section
输入 0 至 100。默认 0，完全不透明。颜色过渡和透明度独立设置。: Enter 0 to 100. The default is 0, fully opaque. The color gradient and transparency are set independently.
当前章之后所有色块的背景透明度: Background transparency for all sections after the current section
色块内边距，单位为磅 (pt): Padding inside section panels, in points (pt)
输入 0 至 20。数值越大，色块上下及标题两侧的留白越多。横条仍按完整章节宽度: Enter 0 to 20. Higher values add space above and below the content and beside each title. Slide bars still use the full section width.
设置铺满页面的平面无缝渐变色块: Apply seamless, flat gradient panels across the slide
章间距设为 0，左右边距设为 0，文字与进度标记间距 3 pt，三侧背景透明度均: Set section gaps and side margins to 0, text-to-marker spacing to 3 pt, and all three background transparencies to 0%. Turn on rounded bars and the current slide glow. Turn off layered navigation and backdrop text. The top position, slide range, and spacing mode stay as set. Select Preview or Generate to apply.
为独立章节面应用轮廓投影，模糊和透明度由下方参数控制: Apply a contour shadow to each section panel using the blur and transparency settings below
启用与页面连续衔接的章节导航: Join the current section to a continuous strip beside the slide content
在完整模式且背景覆盖进度开启时生效。当前章与整体连接条同色一体，连接条始终位于正: Applies in Show All mode with Extend Background Behind Markers on. The section and strip share one color and one contour. The strip faces the slide content. The shadow is cropped at the content edge for a seamless join. Section names, slide bars, and navigation links stay separate.
应用深红当前章与统一浅灰非当前章的层叠样式: Apply a crimson current section and matching light gray surrounding sections
设置铺满页面的无缝同高章节、44.2 pt 大号章体、1 pt 全页连接条、整块: Fill the edge with seamless panels of the same height. Set large panels to 44.2 pt and the full-length strip to 1 pt. Apply contour shadows, rounded bars, and a current slide glow. Turn off backdrop text and side gradients by default. The top position, slide range, and spacing mode stay as set. Select Preview or Generate to apply.
层叠导航沿当前边的总长度: Total length of layered navigation along the selected edge
输入 0 至 4032，0 按沿边两端留白自动铺开。上下停靠使用水平长度，左右侧: Enter 0 to 4032 pt. Use 0 to fill the edge between the start and end margins. Length is horizontal for top and bottom docking and vertical for sidebars. A positive length starts at the leading margin and stays within the slide edge. The connecting strip is at least as long as the navigation.
顶部或底部章节色块的共同高度: Shared section height when docked at the top or bottom
输入 0 至 200 pt。应用预设后，这里显示横向章体的实际高度。输入其他值可: Enter 0 to 200 pt. After applying a preset, this field shows the actual horizontal panel height. Enter a height to set it manually, or enter 0 to fit the text, padding, and markers. For left or right docking, use Sidebar Width.
与当前章节连接的整体条长度: Length of the strip joined to the current section
输入 0 至 4032。0 跟随导航总长，有效长度至少等于导航总长，最大为当前页: Enter 0 to 4032 pt. Use 0 to match the navigation length. The strip is at least as long as the navigation and at most as long as the slide edge. It is centered on the navigation within slide bounds and stays connected to the current section.
输入 0.5 至 30 pt。所有预设的连接条默认均为 1 pt，适用于所有尺寸: Enter 0.5 to 30 pt. The default is 1 pt for every preset size and dock edge. The strip runs between the section panels and the slide content.
完整外轮廓投影的模糊半径: Blur radius for the outer contour shadow
输入 0 至 20，默认 6。0 关闭所有层叠阴影。投影按原生外阴影生成，随后与: Enter 0 to 20 pt. The default is 6 pt. Use 0 to turn off all layered shadows. PowerPoint draws an outer shadow, then crops it with the panel at the strip's content edge. The connection between the section and the strip has no internal seam.
原生阴影的独立透明度: Transparency of the native PowerPoint shadow
输入 0 至 100，默认 80。100 隐藏所有层叠阴影。色块完全透明或关闭背: Enter 0 to 100. The default is 80. Use 100 to hide all layered shadows. A panel with no background or a fully transparent background casts no shadow.
当前底板及最近非当前章节的投影距离: Shadow offset for the current panel and the nearest surrounding sections
输入 0 至 20，默认 1.5。顶部停靠时，当前章与连接条一同向上投影，其他章: Enter 0 to 20 pt. The default is 1.5 pt. When docked at the top, the current section and connecting strip cast one shadow upward. Other sections cast shadows downward, with no horizontal offset. The shadow direction follows the dock edge.
相邻视觉层级的阴影偏移差: Difference in shadow offset between adjacent layers
输入 0 至 5，默认 0.75。每侧紧邻当前章的投影使用基准距离，第二章增加一: Enter 0 to 5 pt. The default is 0.75 pt. On each side of the current section, the nearest section uses the base shadow distance. The second adds one step, and the third and farther sections add two. Nearer sections always stack above farther ones.
顶部模式的可选装饰文字: Optional decorative text for top docking
仅顶部停靠时绘制。直接使用本格章节名，在色块上、正常标题和页条下生成裁切背景字，: With top docking, draw a cropped copy of each noncurrent section name on its panel, behind the title and slide markers. Other dock edges keep the setting without drawing the backdrop. Standard section names remain upright on all four edges.
单独选择裁切背景字的颜色: Choose a separate color for cropped backdrop text
使用调色板或 RGB 数值。背景字颜色独立于正常章节名和格子背景。: Use the palette or enter RGB values. This color is independent of the section title and panel background.
输入 0 至 100。默认 75，只影响超大背景字，不改变正常标题、进度标记或底: Enter 0 to 100. The default is 75. This affects the oversized backdrop letters only. Titles, slide markers, and panels keep their own settings.
以覆盖整个格子的大小为基准放大: Enlarge the backdrop text relative to the panel it covers
输入 110 至 300，默认 150。完整章节名保持比例居中放大，格子边缘裁切: Enter 110 to 300. The default is 150. The full section name enlarges proportionally from the center and is cropped at the panel edges. The backdrop uses the section font in bold.
导航开始处的边距: Margin at the start of the navigation
单位为磅 (pt)。上下停靠对应左边距，左右侧栏对应上边距。0 从页面边端点开始: Measured in points (pt). This is the left margin when docked horizontally or the top margin in a sidebar. Use 0 to start at the slide edge.
导航结束处的边距: Margin at the end of the navigation
单位为磅 (pt)。上下停靠对应右边距，左右侧栏对应下边距。0 延伸到页面边端点: Measured in points (pt). This is the right margin when docked horizontally or the bottom margin in a sidebar. Use 0 to extend to the end of the slide edge.
导航与所选页面边缘的距离: Distance between the navigation and the selected slide edge
单位为磅 (pt)。0 紧贴当前停靠边；正值向页面内部移动，负值可使外侧部分超出: Measured in points (pt). Use 0 to sit flush with the dock edge. Positive values move inward. Negative values may extend beyond the slide. Use Sidebar Width to set sidebar thickness.
调整相邻章节之间的水平间距。: Adjust horizontal spacing between neighboring sections.
章节内部的图标疏密: Spacing of icons within each section
调整同一章节中进度图标的排列间距。过大的正值或负值可能使图标重叠或超出区域。: Adjust the space between progress icons within a section. Large positive or negative values can make icons overlap or extend beyond the section.
章节文字与进度标记之间的垂直距离: Vertical distance between section text and progress markers
默认 3 pt。调整后，背景色块高度随间距同步变化。章节色块模式下负值按 0 处: The default is 3 pt. Panel height adjusts with the spacing. In Section Panels mode, negative values are treated as 0.
将此页标记为跳过，但不会隐藏幻灯片。适合封面和结束页。: Mark this slide as skipped. The slide itself remains visible. Useful for title and closing slides.
复制上一张有效页的进度条，不新增进度图标，也不计入进度页数。适合逐步展开同一内容: Copy the indicators from the previous eligible slide. This slide adds no marker and does not advance the count. Use for slides that reveal the same content in stages.
移除此页的“跳过”或“沿用”标记，恢复正常进度显示。: Clear the Skip or Repeat setting on this slide and restore normal progress.
勾选后，跳过页不显示进度条，沿用页复制上一张有效页的进度。取消勾选后，这些页面按: When selected, skipped slides have no indicators and repeated slides reuse the previous eligible slide's progress. Clear this to count those slides normally.
勾选后，不为 PowerPoint 中已隐藏的幻灯片生成进度图标。: Omit progress icons for slides marked as hidden in PowerPoint.
完整显示：显示章节。仅留空位：隐藏章节内容但保留占位。不显示：忽略章节划分。: Show All displays the sections. Reserve Space hides their content and preserves their space. Hide ignores section divisions.
正常显示章节名称及其占位。: Show section names and reserve their normal space.
隐藏章节内容但保留占位: Hide section content and reserve its space
不显示章节内容，保留章节所需的布局空间。: Hide section content while reserving its space in the layout.
不显示章节文字、背景或占位，按无章节的方式排列。: Omit section text, backgrounds, and spacing, and arrange the indicators as a single group.
选择显示全部进度图标、仅显示当前章节的图标，或不显示图标。: Show all progress icons, just the current section's icons, or no icons.
显示整份演示文稿中所有适用页面的进度图标。: Show progress icons for all eligible slides in the presentation.
仅显示当前章节图标: Show icons for the current section only
只显示当前章节内的进度图标。其宽度仍受章节显示和排列设置影响。: Show icons only in the current section. Their width still depends on section visibility and spacing.
保存、应用、重命名或删除当前文档中的个人预设: Save, apply, rename, or delete personal presets in this presentation
最多 32 个命名预设，名称保留 Unicode 和大小写，保存在当前演示文稿中: Save up to 32 named presets in this presentation. Names preserve Unicode characters and capitalization. A preset restores appearance, layout, count display, density, and long-title settings. Overall counting, visibility rules, and auto-update settings stay as set. Import and export transfer only the current settings. They do not transfer the list of presets or rules.
将进度条配置导出，之后可导入其他演示文稿。Mac 版使用可复制的配置字符串。: Export the indicator settings for use in another presentation. On Mac, copy the settings string.
将之前导出的进度条配置应用到当前演示文稿。导入会立即应用配置。: Apply previously exported indicator settings to this presentation. Imported settings take effect immediately.
建筑方体被转化为可伸缩的取景框。章节采用可变宽的框，子页是离散的小方窗，当前章节: The building's cubic form becomes a frame that can stretch. Each section gets a frame of its own width, with small windows for its slides. The current section changes background color, and the current window fills in.
楼外竖幅把方形留白置于上下两行之间，框内外的信息有各自位置。: On the vertical banner outside the building, a square opening sits between two lines of type, giving information separate spaces inside and outside the frame.
AutoCAD 图例构成一致的工程符号语法。章节端点对应对位点，五页为一组的长短: AutoCAD symbols supply a shared visual language. Crosshairs mark the section ends. Slide ticks are grouped in fives, and past ticks darken.
同一张图将平面图中的墙体线、门扇和短划重新组合成人脸与字母。: In the same image, wall lines, door swings, and dashes from a floor plan are rearranged into a face and letters.
围绕舞台就座的平面关系转化成框景。四个角界定每章，中心空间留给标题，圆节点以实心: The seating plan around a stage becomes a frame. Four corners define each section and leave room for the title in the center. Filled and hollow dots indicate slide states.
票券上的边缘方块与弧段围出正文空间，标题仍能独立阅读。: On the tickets, blocks and arcs around the edges frame the text and leave the title easy to read.
固定网格接受不同社区输入。导航按章节划格，并在各格中排列相同尺度的页块，当前格反: A fixed grid accommodates contributions from different communities. Each section gets a cell with slide squares of the same size. The current cell reverses color, and upcoming slides use outlined squares.
固定外轮廓容纳多组可替换的模块，改变内部排列仍能识别整体。: A fixed outline holds interchangeable groups of modules. The overall form stays recognizable when the modules change places.
克制的文字层级和固定秩序给内容留白。带细线的书目式分栏容纳章节名，页轨只在当前页: Restrained typography and a consistent layout leave room for the content. Fine rules divide the section names into catalog columns. The track thickens only at the current slide.
小号居中题字叠在木构架照片上，名称与年份组成两个层级。: A small, centered inscription sits on a photograph of a timber frame. The name and year form two levels of type.
按时期编排的字体样本适合用统一测量基准比较。这里用双横线、编号样本栏与长短页刻度: Type specimens arranged by period invite comparison on a common scale. Double rules, numbered specimen columns, and long and short slide ticks organize the index. The current section reverses color.
展开页把放大的字样与密排说明分在左右两栏，读者可以区分样本与索引。: A spread places enlarged type specimens on one side and dense notes on the other, clearly separating specimens from the index.
元素表式封面和百科内页分出标识与正文层级。每章保留标签端线和独立名称，逐页节点采: The periodic-table cover and encyclopedic pages distinguish labels from body text. Each section keeps its own name and label marks. Fill, outline, and transparency distinguish slide states.
书封把大字母与窄幅纸带叠置，封面主名和纸带说明各占一个层级。: A narrow paper band crosses a large letter on the cover. The title and the band's text occupy separate levels.
分章存放的图录与档案盒标签启发索引卡片。每章用短回折线、等宽编号和页块组成一张卡: The catalog's chapters and archive box labels suggest index cards. Short hooked lines, monospaced numbers, and slide blocks form each card. A side accent marks the current card.
图录封面采用档案盒标签，书口的红色图案在叠放时仍能辨识。: An archive box label appears on the cover. A red motif on the page edges stays visible when the books are stacked.
获奖项目的街头海报把城市轮廓压缩为水平色带。章节变成对齐的彩色字段，色带边线划分: Street posters for the project reduce the city's skyline to horizontal bands. Sections become aligned fields of color. Band edges separate the sections, and progress follows a continuous track.
海报矩阵将地平线划分为对齐的色带，同一套分区容纳不同景观。: A grid of posters divides horizons into aligned bands of color. The same divisions accommodate different landscapes.
泳池地线在转弯和门口仍维持方向连续。章节框各自围住一段页轨，相邻页段无缝拼接，粗: The pool's floor markings keep their direction through turns and doorways. Each section encloses a length of track. Adjacent slide segments meet, and a thick cursor shows the current position.
泳馆指引线沿墙转弯，局部变形为推门、楼梯等提示，行进方向仍可追踪。: Wayfinding lines turn along the pool walls and become cues for doors and stairs. Their direction remains easy to follow.
小报幅面将内容压缩到高密度的编辑层级。导航以细栏线分章，把标题与刻度分开排，当前: The tabloid format fits a dense editorial hierarchy into a small space. Fine rules divide the sections. Titles sit apart from ticks, and a heavier top rule and bolder type mark the current section.
改版首版在标题下使用窄文字栏，横跨栏目的主图与竖向栏线同时存在。: The redesigned front page uses narrow text columns beneath the headlines. A lead photograph spans several columns alongside vertical rules.
标准厨柜的格网比例同时组织字标与应用。章节占据不同宽度的柜格，页段排入柜格，当前: The proportions of standard kitchen cabinets organize both the wordmark and its applications. Sections occupy compartments of different widths, each holding slide segments. Fill changes identify the active cell and the slides already visited.
上下两排矩形分格总宽相同，但内部格宽不同，黑色间隔把每格边界固定下来。: Two rows of rectangular compartments have the same total width but different cell widths. Black gutters define each cell.
